info.title: Al-Sahel Cafe Supplies API
info.description: REST API documentation split by platform: Admin Dashboard, Customer Mobile App, and Public Storefront.

post.summary: Log in and receive an access token
post.description: Customer users must login with phone_number and password. The response is a bare bearer token with no permissions. Admin and delegate users may use email instead of phone_number and will receive permissions in the response.

post.summary: Register a customer account (OTP verification required before login)
post.description: Creates an inactive customer user and sends a 6-digit OTP. Verify it via POST /customer/verify-otp: when customer_auto_approve is active a bearer token is returned immediately, otherwise the account waits for admin approval and only a message is returned.
When customer_auto_approve is active the user is activated and a bearer token is returned immediately. Otherwise the account stays inactive until an admin approves it, and only a message is returned.

200.description: Authenticated user details. has_addresses is true when the user has at least one address (branch); addresses_count gives the number.

post.summary: Place an order directly (without the cart)

get.description: Light order cards for one address. Address details are at GET /customer/addresses/{id}. meta.counts gives the number per tab (all / active / completed / cancelled) and per status; it honours from, to and q but not status or group, so tab badges stay stable. Open GET /customer/orders/{id} for the full order.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Tab: active (pending, confirmed, preparing, out_for_delivery, cancellation_requested), completed (delivered, received), cancelled

404.description: Address not found or not yours

put.summary: Confirm receipt of a delivered order

post.summary: Ask the admins to cancel a pending order

get.description: Address details with delivery zone and price. Orders of an address are a separate call: GET /customer/addresses/{id}/orders. data.delivery_price is the price at the customer's registered location (used when there are no addresses yet).

200.description: Address with delivery zone and price

404.description: Address not found or not yours

delete.description: Soft delete; past orders keep their own copy of the delivery address.

200.description: User fields merged with the customer profile, plus addresses. user.has_addresses is true once the customer has at least one address (branch); user.addresses_count gives the number.

get.summary: Active delivery zones for the map

get.description: Each category carries image_url (its own picture, or the shared default) and image_type (uploaded / placeholder).

Text search covers product name, brand, description, tags, category and size name / SKU / barcode. Filters combine with AND; list filters accept comma-separated values. Use GET /customer/products/filters for the available options and counts.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: One or more category ids, e.g. 1,4 (sub-categories included)

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Products with at least one size at or above this price

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Products with at least one size at or below this price

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default: relevance when q is given, otherwise newest

200.description: data: product cards; meta: pagination + applied filters

default_variant_id.description: The matched size when the query matched a size/SKU/barcode

get.summary: Filter options with counts for the current search
get.description: Accepts the same parameters as GET /customer/products. Each facet is counted as if its own filter were not applied, so users can switch between options.

get.summary: Home-screen product sections (paginated): title + first products in one object
get.description:
Each section shows up to its products_limit products. Sections are either hand-picked by the admin (source=manual, admin order) or rule-based (source=filter, e.g. sort=popular for best sellers or price_asc for cheapest). Sections without available products are left out of the page.

**View all:** when `has_more` is `true`, show a «عرض الكل (products_total)» button that opens `GET /customer/featured-sections/{id}/products` (see the guide at the top of Customer Products).

get.summary: All products of a section (paginated) for 'view all'
get.description:
Screen opened from a section's «عرض الكل» button.

1. Request `page=1` and show `section.title` and `meta.total`.
2. On scroll end, while `meta.current_page < meta.last_page`, request the next `page` and append the results.

Page 1 starts from the beginning of the section (it repeats the products already shown on the home screen, in the same order) — render the response as-is. The order is fixed by the section type. Returns 404 when the section is hidden or deleted.

200.description: section {id,title,source,sort}, data: product cards in the section's order, meta: pagination

get.summary: Stock availability for the cart items

post.summary: Add an item to the shopping cart (sets its quantity)
Turn the shopping cart into an order

payment_method.description: wallet = pay the full total from the wallet now

get.summary: Live location of the order's delegate

receipt.description: Transfer receipt: jpg/png/webp/heic or pdf, max 5MB

post.summary: Start an online top-up; open checkout_url to pay

201.description: topup + checkout_url; the wallet is credited when the gateway confirms

200.description: data: product cards with favorited_at; meta: current_page, per_page, total, last_page

get.summary: Ids of my favorite products (to mark hearts in lists)

post.summary: Request password reset OTP for customer user
Reset customer user password with OTP

get.summary: Default image used when a record has no picture
get.description: Public SVG placeholder. image_url falls back to this URL, so clients can always render an image. Kinds: product.svg, promo.svg, category.svg, customer.svg, user.svg.

200.description: Carts with items and current subtotal

post.summary: Place an order from a recurring cart
post.description: The cart is kept as-is so it can be ordered again; prices are the current ones.

post.summary: Payment gateway callback (signed); credits the wallet on success

get.summary: Feature flags for the app UI

user_id.description: Required for admin requests; customers always create addresses for themselves.

image.description: Category picture; send as multipart/form-data. Leave it out to keep the current one.
Stored as the product's primary image

ProductVariantRequest.description: A sellable size of a product. Stock lives in inventories; expiry dates on purchase order items.

InventoryRequest.description: POST receives goods (adds to stock, purchase movement); PUT sets the counted on-hand quantity (adjustment movement).

AuthLoginRequest.description: Customer users must login with phone_number and password only. Email is allowed for admin and delegate users only.

email.description: Use for admin/delegate login only. Customer users must NOT use email.

AuthResponse.description: For customer users the response contains only the bearer token. Admin and delegate responses also include permissions.

token.description: Bearer token to use in the Authorization header

permissions.description: Included for admin/delegate users only. Omitted for customer users.

OrderItemRequest.description: Unit price is always taken from the variant on the server.

OrderRequest.description: Totals, delivery fee and the delivery address snapshot are computed on the server.

user_id.description: The customer the order is for

tags.name: Customer Products
tags.description:
التصنيفات، المنتجات والبحث بالفلاتر، تفاصيل المنتج وأحجامه، والأقسام المميزة.

## أقسام الرئيسية و«عرض الكل»

**1. الرئيسية** — `GET /customer/featured-sections`

كل قسم يرجع أول N منتج فقط (N يحدده الأدمن) مع:
- `products_total`: عدد كل منتجات القسم
- `has_more`: `true` إذا كان هناك منتجات أكثر من المعروضة

اعرض عنوان القسم ومنتجاته، وإذا كان `has_more = true` أضف زر **«عرض الكل (products_total)»**.

**2. شاشة «عرض الكل»** — `GET /customer/featured-sections/{id}/products?page=1&per_page=20`

```json
{
  "section": { "id": 1, "title": "الأكثر مبيعاً", "source": "filter", "sort": "popular" },
  "data": [ "...كروت المنتجات..." ],
  "meta": { "current_page": 1, "per_page": 20, "total": 12, "last_page": 1 }
}
```

العنوان من `section.title` والعدد من `meta.total`.

**3. تحميل المزيد (infinite scroll)** — عند الوصول لآخر القائمة وطالما `meta.current_page < meta.last_page` اطلب `page` التالية وأضف النتائج تحت الموجودة.

**ملاحظات**
- الصفحة الأولى تبدأ من بداية القسم (تشمل منتجات الرئيسية نفسها بنفس الترتيب) — اعرض الرد كما هو ولا تدمجه مع منتجات الرئيسية.
- الترتيب ثابت حسب نوع القسم: الأكثر مبيعاً بالمبيعات، الأقل سعراً بالسعر، واليدوي بترتيب الأدمن.
- القسم المخفي أو المحذوف يرجع `404` — ارجع للرئيسية أو اعرض «القسم غير متاح».
- الكارت نفسه في كل الشاشات: `is_favorite` للقلب، `in_stock` للتوفر، و`default_variant_id` لإضافة سريعة عبر `POST /customer/cart/items`.
- `per_page` الافتراضي 20 والحد الأقصى 100.

tags.name: Customer Favorites
tags.description:
إضافة المنتجات للمفضلة وإزالتها وعرضها.

## القلب الأحمر `is_favorite`

كل منتج يرجع للتطبيق يحمل `is_favorite` (`true` = اعرض القلب أحمر) للمستخدم الحالي:

| المكان | الحقل |
|---|---|
| قائمة المنتجات والبحث `GET /customer/products` | `data[].is_favorite` |
| تفاصيل المنتج `GET /customer/products/{id}` | `is_favorite` |
| أقسام الرئيسية `GET /customer/featured-sections` | `data[].products[].is_favorite` |
| عرض الكل `GET /customer/featured-sections/{id}/products` | `data[].is_favorite` |
| المفضلة `GET /customer/favorites` | `data[].is_favorite` (دائماً `true`) |
| السلة `GET /customer/cart` | `data.items[].product_variant.product.is_favorite` |
| الطلبيات المتكررة `GET /customer/recurring-carts` و `/{id}` | `items[].product_variant.product.is_favorite` |

**عند الضغط على القلب:** `POST /customer/favorites` بـ `{ "product_id": 5 }` للإضافة، و `DELETE /customer/favorites/{productId}` للإزالة. الاستدعاءان آمنان للتكرار ويرجعان `is_favorite` و `favorites_count`، فحدّث القلب محلياً مباشرة دون إعادة تحميل القائمة.

لتلوين القلوب في شاشة لا تحمل الحقل يمكن جلب الأرقام مرة واحدة من `GET /customer/favorites/ids`.
